distinctness.S-1C: Funding-level settlement event and immediate post-settlement unwind; S-1M uses a robust own-history second difference and enters at the next full hour.
distinctness.S-1D: Cross-sectional cumulative funding rank and multi-day carry; S-1M never ranks funding levels across contracts and holds at most two later settlements.
distinctness.S-1G: Spot-hedged cash-and-carry; S-1M has no Spot leg and does not book forecast funding.
distinctness.S-1H: BTC/ETH relative basis residual with funding excluded as signal; S-1M uses settled funding acceleration only.
distinctness.S-1I: Cross-sectional Premium Index level dislocation with funding excluded as signal; S-1M uses neither premium nor basis.
distinctness.S-1J: Reserved Spot-hedged funding carry family; S-1M has one USD-M perpetual leg.
distinctness.S-1K: Reserved COIN-M versus USD-M family; S-1M uses USD-M only.
distinctness.S-1L: Reserved dated-future calendar basis family; S-1M uses perpetuals only.

universe.lifecycleRule: retain every selected symbol; a trailing suffix with no official monthly fundingRate object makes that symbol inactive from the first absent month, requires no contract/mark archive because no funding-acceleration signal exists, and can never trigger replacement

signal.rateNormalization: x_j = funding_rate * 10000 * 8 / funding_interval_hours, in eight-hour-equivalent basis points
signal.cadenceNormalization: d_j = observed hours since j-1 divided by 8
signal.robustZ: z_j = (a_j - median(previous L accelerations)) / max(1.4826 * MAD(previous L accelerations), 0.05)
signal.decisionReady: first complete UTC hour strictly after exact funding timestamp
signal.simultaneousSelection: largest absolute z, then largest prior complete 24-hour quote volume, then symbol
signal.rearm: same symbol requires abs(z) below 1 after a close

trials.selectionOrdering: highest development stress net, then lower stress hourly drawdown, then lexical trialId
trials.admissionTarget: THE_SINGLE_SELECTED_CHAMPION; its Holm hypothesis and alpha/16 lower bound must pass after the 16-trial family is evaluated

entryAndExit.takerQuantity: quantity = 1000 / unadjusted entry-reference open; adverse execution is a separate cash cost and never moves the signal or reference price
entryAndExit.entryReference: contract kline open at first full UTC hour strictly after signal funding timestamp
exitTriggers: first later funding acceleration opposite entry acceleration
frozen maximum later funding settlement count
entryAndExit.exitReference: contract kline open at first full UTC hour strictly after trigger funding timestamp
entryAndExit.fundingAtExitTrigger: included because the position existed at that settlement
entryAndExit.causalBoundaryBuffer: entry is ineligible during the final (24 * maximumSubsequentFundingSettlements + 1) hours of a partition; if an earlier selected signal still lacks a later exit-trigger funding event, the evaluation is terminal UNMEASURED rather than future-filtered

economics.fillNotional: entry absolute notional plus abs(quantity * exitReferenceOpen)
economics.feeCashCost: scenario fee rate multiplied by each fill's absolute notional
economics.executionCashCost: scenario adverse-execution rate multiplied by each fill's absolute notional
economics.fundingCashFlow: sum of event cash flows after entry signal and through the exit trigger, with scenario favorable/adverse multipliers applied per event
economics.net: price gross + adjusted funding - fees - adverse execution
economics.makerDiagnostic: maker-limit price gross and funding, 2 bp maker entry fee plus 1 bp entry adverse-selection cost, then 4 bp taker exit fee plus 2 bp taker-exit adverse-execution cost
economics.rounding: Decimal arithmetic; JSON monetary fields rounded to 0.00000001 USD only at serialization

funding.eventSelection: exact archived settlement timestamps while position is open, including exit-trigger settlement

statistics.dailyAttribution: each completed trade's full net is assigned to its exit UTC day; every other valid calendar day is an explicit zero
statistics.bootstrapStatistic: total stress net USD per original 1000 over the complete partition calendar
statistics.synchronization: each replicate uses the same circular seven-day block-start sequence for all 16 trial daily series
statistics.oneSidedPValue: (1 + count of centered-null bootstrap totals greater than or equal to observed total) / (4096 + 1)
statistics.quantileConvention: sorted empirical values at zero-based index ceil(q * N) - 1, clamped to [0,N-1]
statistics.multiplicity: ONE_SIDED_HOLM_STEP_DOWN_ACROSS_ALL_16_SYNCHRONOUS_DAILY_SERIES; sort p then trialId, reject while p_i <= 0.05/(16-i); champion must be among rejected hypotheses
statistics.familywiseLowerBound: champion uncentered percentile-bootstrap lower bound at q=0.05/16 must be strictly positive

pbo.coreSelection: the final 264 development UTC days ending 2026-04-01 exclusive; earlier development days are excluded only from PBO
pbo.selection: six in-sample blocks; highest stress daily mean then lexical trialId
pbo.oosRank: rank all 16 trials by six-block out-of-sample stress daily mean descending then lexical trialId; rank 1 is best
pbo.logit: lambda = log(((17-rank)/17) / (rank/17)); lambda < 0 exactly when rank > 8
pbo.overfitEvent: selected in-sample champion has out-of-sample rank greater than 8

statistics.holdoutInterval: two-sided 95 percent circular seven-day block bootstrap of total stress net USD per original 1000

capacity.basis: minimum of prior complete UTC-day quote volume and median preceding seven complete UTC-day quote volumes
capacity.gatePredicate: every completed trade must have capacity proxy >= 1000; zero completed trades fails sample admission before capacity can authorize anything

developmentAdmission.gateTarget: single champion selected across all 16 trials before filtering

riskAndConcentration.drawdownCurve: hourly mark-price-open liquidation-equity proxy while a taker position is active, including incurred entry cost and settled funding through the observation time, reserving the scenario exit fee and adverse-execution cost; exact realized net at exit; flat hours carry realized equity
riskAndConcentration.drawdownThreshold: maximum peak-to-trough loss divided by 1000 must be <= 0.10
riskAndConcentration.activeWeek: ISO UTC year-week containing a trade exit
riskAndConcentration.symbolAttribution: full trade net attributed to its traded symbol
riskAndConcentration.monthAttribution: full trade net attributed to exit UTC calendar month
riskAndConcentration.removeBest: total stress net minus the largest strictly positive group contribution; must remain strictly positive

dataValidity.archivePreFreezeAccess: screen may parse only April-June 2025 rows; prepare may hash every declared ZIP and open only its sole member header, never an outcome row
dataValidity.developmentRunAccess: after RUN_CONSUMED exists, parse only April 2025 through March 2026 rows
dataValidity.holdoutAccess: April-June 2026 rows may be parsed only after development_result and candidate_seal exist, all development gates pass, and HOLDOUT_OPEN is atomically written
dataValidity.duplicates: duplicate funding timestamps or hourly open times are terminal UNMEASURED
dataValidity.hourlyBars: contract and mark series must be unique and exactly one hour apart throughout every opened month range; any gap is terminal UNMEASURED
dataValidity.fundingCadence: elapsed milliseconds must match either the preceding or current archived funding_interval_hours within 1000 ms; otherwise terminal UNMEASURED
dataValidity.lifecycleAbsence: after at least one complete selected month, a trailing suffix of absent official fundingRate monthly objects is a frozen inactive lifecycle, not a gap; a later reappearance is terminal UNMEASURED; the exact selected symbol remains and is never replaced
dataValidity.history: a signal is ineligible until exactly L preceding acceleration observations exist; this is not missing evidence
dataValidity.causalPrice: any missing entry, exit, active-settlement mark proxy, prior-24h volume, or drawdown mark for a selected trade is terminal UNMEASURED

freezeBindings: source_manifest.v1.json including every publisher and verified archive digest
CUSTODY_BREACH.v1.json when present; its presence forces terminal UNMEASURED before any outcome row is opened by the runner

terminal.UNMEASURED: invalid custody, checksum/schema/cadence, causal price gap, marker or digest drift, or otherwise incomplete economics
terminal.NO_GO: valid measured evidence fails an economic, multiplicity, sample, concentration, drawdown, or capacity proxy gate
terminal.GO: reserved for a fully measured positive result with independently proven account-effective fees, maker/execution validity, historical filters, and executable capacity
requiredResultFields: headline base/stress/severe net USD per original 1000
holdout state and two-sided interval or unopened reason
16-trial Holm state, alpha/16 lower bound, and PBO
provenance digests, one-run markers, consumer, and authority
